name: Creamy Tuna Salad with Celery Sticks
ingredients: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water
instructions: Drain and mince capers. Place in a medium bowl along with yogurt, mayo, and spices. Stir to combine the dressing.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Drain tuna, add to bowl, and flake with a fork. Stir to combine the tuna salad and set aside.
Wash, dry, and trim celery; cut crosswise into 3-inch long sticks.
Divide tuna salad between plates and serve with celery sticks. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
